notes: - Check updates now performs a manual update check and reports when no update is available - Full Quiz now loads correctly again - Reset quiz progress now shows only quizzes with guessed Pokemon, lists guessed count and elapsed time, and supports resetting one quiz at a time with confirmation - Singleplayer progress now starts saving only after at least one Pokemon has been guessed - Improved background color slider placement in singleplayer and co-op so it stays fixed while scrolling - Improved co-op chat placement and removed the message character limit - Added app/taskbar notification and sound when someone joins a co-op lobby - Cleaned up co-op lobby player colors and UI overlap around patch notes/reset controls
